subjects.description: A full-size humanoid robot with a predominantly white exterior shell and exposed black and metallic mechanical components at the joints. The robot has a smooth, featureless white head with no eyes, mouth, nose, or other facial features. Its body has a slender, streamlined humanoid structure with visible mechanical joints and segmented white armor panels.
subjects.appearance_details: The robot has a clean white exterior with black mechanical components visible between the body panels, particularly around the shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, and ankles. Its head is a completely smooth, blank white shell with no facial features or illuminated elements. The torso, arms, and legs are composed of multiple articulated sections, giving it a distinctly robotic and mechanical appearance. The white body panels catch the surrounding light with subtle highlights and reflections.
subjects.relationship: Sole active subject in the scene, standing in a dark studio-like environment
subjects.location: Center-left of frame, standing on a dark floor
subjects.orientation: Facing slightly toward the camera, with its body oriented somewhat to the right
subjects.pose: Standing upright with both arms hanging naturally at its sides and both feet positioned on the floor
subjects.action: Walks toward the right, makes direct contact with the wall, then kneels down
subjects.state_changes: The robot walks continuously toward the right side of the room until its body directly contacts the wall. The robot must visibly reach the wall before changing its movement. Upon contact, its forward motion stops abruptly and its upper body and head move slightly backward from the contact. It then pauses briefly, slowly bends both knees, lowers its body to the floor, and transitions into a kneeling position. After kneeling, it raises both hands toward its blank face and makes small, subtle up-and-down movements with its head.
subjects.facial_features: None. The head is a completely smooth, featureless white shell with no eyes, mouth, nose, lights, or facial markings.

background_setting: A dark, studio-like indoor space with a black and deep gray color palette, featuring a smooth dark gray or black floor that subtly reflects the lighting. The background wall is almost black, with a simple, minimalist appearance and no visible decorations or furniture. Strong, cool-white lighting illuminates the left and central areas, creating sharp highlights and a dramatic contrast between the brightly lit subject area and the dark surroundings. On the right side of the background, large, soft-edged shadows are cast onto the wall, with their outlines appearing faintly through the darkness. The floor and wall blend together naturally in the low light, making the space appear large, empty, and open. The overall setting resembles a modern exhibition space or professional photography studio, with a minimalist composition, extensive negative space on the right, dramatic low-key lighting, and a quiet yet slightly tense atmosphere.

actions.description: The featureless white humanoid robot walks continuously toward the right side of the room. It does not kneel, stop, or raise its hands during this interval.
The robot reaches the wall and its body visibly makes direct contact with the wall. The forward motion stops at the moment of contact, and the robot's upper body and head recoil slightly backward.
After the wall contact, the robot remains briefly stationary, then slowly bends both knees and lowers its body into a kneeling position.
The robot remains kneeling, raises both hands toward its featureless head with the palms facing inward, and makes very small, slow up-and-down movements with its head.

From 0:00 to 0:02, the robot continuously walks toward the right side of the room. During this entire interval, it does not kneel, stop, or raise its hands. At approximately 0:02, the robot reaches the wall and makes direct physical contact with it. Its forward movement stops at the exact moment of contact, and its upper body and head recoil slightly backward. From 0:03 to 0:05, the robot remains briefly stationary and then slowly bends both knees and lowers its body into a kneeling position. From 0:05 to 0:07, the robot remains on its knees, raises both hands toward its completely featureless head with the palms facing inward, and makes very small, slow up-and-down movements with its head.
